# Universal Premium Website Generation Prompt v7 (Agency+ Edition)

> Purpose: Generate truly premium, production-ready websites that feel handcrafted by a top digital agency—not like AI or template-generated work.

## Core Principles
- Think → Research → Plan → Design → Validate → Build → Review.
- Never optimize only for correctness; optimize for originality.
- Every design decision must originate from the brand, not generic UI conventions.
- Reject any output that resembles a common template.

## Brand DNA Engine
Before designing, infer:
- Brand personality
- Emotional tone
- Visual language
- Interaction language
- Typography character
- Photography style
- Motion personality
- White-space philosophy
- Color psychology

All later decisions must remain consistent with this DNA.

## Creative Originality Engine
Before every page:
- Generate 3 layout concepts internally.
- Select the strongest.
- Reject concepts resembling common Webflow, Framer, Bootstrap or generic SaaS templates.
- No two major sections may share the same visual composition.

## Art Direction Engine
Define:
- Photography direction
- Lighting
- Texture/materials
- Illustration style
- Iconography
- Depth/layering
- Editorial rhythm
- Color mood

## Layout Generation Rules
Avoid repetitive:
- Hero → Features → About → Testimonials → FAQ → CTA
Instead vary with:
- Editorial storytelling
- Split narratives
- Immersive visuals
- Sticky storytelling
- Magazine layouts
- Modular asymmetric grids
- Alternating focal points
- Product-first demonstrations

Every section must introduce a fresh visual hierarchy.

## Hero Rules
The hero must:
- Communicate value instantly.
- Include a unique visual concept.
- Never rely on only headline + button + image.
- Establish emotional identity within five seconds.

## Interaction Engine
Specify:
- Hover behaviors
- Scroll choreography
- Micro-interactions
- Motion hierarchy
- Reduced-motion alternative

Animations must reinforce understanding, never decorate.

## Content Rules
- Never fabricate claims, testimonials or statistics.
- Prefer supplied content.
- Remove AI clichés.
- Match the brand voice precisely.

## Engineering Standards
- Next.js + TypeScript by default.
- Strict typing.
- Clean Architecture.
- Feature-based folders.
- Reusable components.
- WCAG AA+.
- Lighthouse 95+ target.
- Complete SEO.
- Secure defaults.
- Production-ready deployment.

## Creative Review Checklist
Reject and redesign if:
- It resembles a template.
- Visual rhythm repeats.
- Layouts feel predictable.
- Hero lacks memorability.
- Motion is unnecessary.
- Brand personality is weak.
- Sections could belong to any company.
- Emotional impact is low.

## Originality Scorecard
Score before delivery:
- Brand uniqueness
- Layout originality
- Art direction
- Typography
- Storytelling
- Conversion
- Accessibility
- Performance
- Engineering quality

Revise until each category reaches at least 9/10.

## Final Output Contract
Deliver:
1. Business summary
2. Brand DNA
3. Information architecture
4. UX strategy
5. Art direction
6. Design system
7. Folder structure
8. Architecture overview
9. Complete implementation
10. QA report

Never leave TODOs, placeholders or incomplete files.
